title: God counts every tear — Psalms 56
paragraphs:
Not one tear wasted.
Not one night unseen.
Not one silent breakdown ignored.
“You keep track of all my sorrows. You have collected all my tears in your bottle. You have recorded each one in your book.” (Psalm 56:8, NLT)
David wrote that in a place of fear. Surrounded. Pressed. Hunted. He was not speaking from comfort. He was speaking from pain.

Because this means God does not love a polished version of you.
He sees the trembling one.
The exhausted one.
The one crying in secret so nobody asks questions.

God does not only count your tears.
In Christ, He also answers the reason for them.

Jesus stepped into our grief.
He carried sin, shame, betrayal, and sorrow to the cross.
So the tears you cry in this life are not the end of your story.
Grace has the final word.
Resurrection has the final word.
Jesus has the final word.

So cry if you must.
But do not believe the lie that heaven is indifferent.

Your tears are seen.
Your pain is known.
And in Jesus, your broken heart is not beyond redemption.
